title: Sim Status Rule Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: MicroSims
Batch Generation
Status Lifecycle
Automation
Rule-Based Systems
description: A p5.js rule explorer for the MicroSim status lifecycle. Learners set whether the sim directory, main.html and a chapter iframe exist, the .js line count, the quality score and a Reused flag, predict the status extract-sim-specs.py assigns, and see the ordered rule that decided it.
audience: Teachers, instructional designers, learning-technology developers and learning-analytics practitioners (college undergraduate and professional development)

educational.topic: Deriving MicroSim lifecycle status from files on disk
learningObjectives: The learner will predict the status that the extraction script assigns to a MicroSim given the state of its files, and will explain which rule produced the result.
prerequisites: The status lifecycle and sim status file (Chapter 14)

accessibility.notes: All inputs are native checkboxes, sliders, a button and a select; rule outcomes are spelled out in words, not only by color

controls.label: Sim directory exists
controls.purpose: Whether docs/sims/<sim-id>/ exists (unchecking also removes main.html)

controls.label: main.html exists
controls.purpose: Whether the directory holds main.html (checking also creates the directory)

controls.label: Chapter has an iframe
controls.purpose: Deployed needs validated plus a chapter iframe

controls.label: Predict first
controls.purpose: Hide the result until the learner chooses a status

controls.label: Choose a status
controls.purpose: Record the prediction (clicking a strip box also works)

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Predict-then-reveal practice with an ordered rule trace
keyQuestions: Why does an iframe not make an implemented sim deployed?
What status does a 50-line .js file give, and why?
Why can a sim with complete files still be reported as reused?
commonMisconceptions: Any .js file makes a sim implemented
An iframe alone makes a sim deployed
Status is typed into the status file by a person
assessmentOpportunities: Naming the rule that decided a status
Explaining why recomputed status makes the pipeline resumable
